# Notis

> Notis is a handwritten notebook app for school and university. It runs on iPhone, iPad and in the browser.

Notis (not Notion) is a notes app for students and teachers in German-speaking schools. You write with a stylus or mouse, import PDFs, keep a timetable, record grades and study with flashcards. Notes stay on the device first. Cloud sync with Google or Apple is optional.

- Home: https://notis-notizbuecher.web.app/
- Web app: https://notis-notizbuecher.web.app/app/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/notis/id6801918801
- Privacy: https://notis-notizbuecher.web.app/datenschutz
- Terms: https://notis-notizbuecher.web.app/agb

Free writing. Optional Lite and Pro plans for backup and sync. Android / Google Play is coming later.
